question: Is model-free receipt missing from the household voice server?
result: No new receipt implementation is needed for continuous household voice. The active speaker already includes the shared receipt.
mechanism: HouseholdCoreClient inherits CoreClient.events; shared EvaAgent speaks the received-input event independently of the eventual model response.
remainingGap: The native HA ConversationEntity awaits the complete JSON response. Physical continuous speech requires the separately prepared continuous device firmware, verified recovery, activation and real trial.
limits: Read-only source/runtime composition evidence, not physical audible latency.
No claim of current physical device firmware readback in this check.
Ordinary HA pipeline and continuous speaker route are different transports; server readiness does not prove physical route activation.
